hold_text: This PR adds research/queue/RQ-20261007-022..009.yaml and research/queue/blocked/RQ-20261007-031..012.yaml as NEW files -- pre-registered decision rules -- which STAMP_ONLY_SURFACE and TIER1_SURFACE deliberately cannot vouch for (E57: 'registering a decision rule is exactly the act R5/E57's own comment says must hold for a human'; identical precedent w6-srq-regime-weighting.json / PR #13081). Every other changed path (docs/claude/work/pipeline/*.json, .github/pr-landing, .github/pr-automerge-requests, .github/merge-slots) is Tier-1 surface. Tier-1 research work: no src/, config/, order-path, roster or live-VM file is touched; held only because the guard correctly cannot certify twelve brand-new decision-rule files as a stamp. The dispatch brief's LANDING clause names the manager (Manager Session 2026-10-01) as the human who lands it.
why: Lane RESEARCH-FOLLOWUPS (Manager Session 2026-10-01, session_01MM8o5js6TcDFeNAPBY4Ntv; ceiling $25). Registers twelve research-queue units (research/queue/RQ-20261007-022..009 and research/queue/blocked/RQ-20261007-031..012), each with a decision rule registered BEFORE the run, the statistic, the n floor and its power basis declared from a COMMITTED evidence record (never a memo), the full cost stack, and the harness/workflow the dispatcher can route (m20-exit-lever-sweep.yml, research-script-run.yml, or session-local with the exact command where no dispatchable route exists). Appends ten records to docs/claude/work/pipeline/ marking PI-20261004-P24XMV4V-0001..0004, PI-20261004-UQ9JJPRQ-0001/-0002, PI-20261005-XJSGZG1X-0002, PI-20261006-1BPXEUJR-0001 and PI-20261005-OAKGATE1-0002 routed to their unit ids, and PI-20261004-APBY4NTV-0001 done (its own rerun condition is satisfied: all five units re-ran 2026-10-04 with n >= 39). Tier-1 by the canonical doc's own list: research registers and the pipeline store only. No src/, no config/, no order path, no roster, no deploy, no live-VM runtime file. E57 note: a NEW hand-written queue unit is a pre-registered decision rule that STAMP_ONLY_SURFACE deliberately cannot vouch for; if pr-landing-guard holds this PR on that ground, the manager lands it (dispatch brief, LANDING clause).
